onboarding_recovery_notice.message: Your saved setup progress could not be restored. Anzaing again with your current defaults.

onboarding_complete_body.message: Your choices are saved. Fungua Fokasi Lock from the Chrome toolbar to start a session.

onboarding_save_error.message: Haiwezi kuhifadhi maendeleo ya kuanzisha. Jaribu tena.

onboarding_enable_error.message: Haiwezi kuwezesha kuzuia tovuti. Jaribu tena.

onboarding_finish_error.message: Haiwezi kumaliza kuanzisha. Chaguzi zako bado zimehifadhiwa. Jaribu tena.

onboarding_lists_heading.message: Chagua orodha yako ya kuzuia mwanzo

onboarding_lists_blacklist_rule.message: Katika $MODE$, kategori zilizowezwa na tovuti za kuzuia ziada hazipo.

onboarding_lists_whitelist_rule.message: Katika $MODE$, kila tovuti si ya kupatikana isipokuwa orodha yako ya kuruhusu.

onboarding_lists_defaults_note.message: Chaguzi hizi zinakuwa chaguo-msingi kwa vikao vya baadaye. Unaweza kuzibadilisha baadaye.

onboarding_access_local_matching.message: Fokasi Lock checks page addresses locally so it can match your selected categories and sites. It uses website access to show its blocking screen and restore affected pages when your session ends.

onboarding_access_capability_intro.message: Kategori na vikoa vya kawaida vinaweza kuwa na tovuti yoyote. Chrome itaomba kwa hiyo uwezo huu:

onboarding_access_capability.message: Soma na badilisha data yako yote kwenye tovuti zote

onboarding_access_scope_note.message: Fokasi Lock uses that access only while applying your blocking rules.

onboarding_access_denied.message: Chrome haikutoa upatikanaji wa tovuti. Unaweza kujaribu tena.

onboarding_access_registration_error.message: Tovuti access is granted, but Fokasi Lock could not enable blocking. Jaribu Tena setup or reload the extension.

onboarding_sync_heading.message: Chagua mahali ambapo mipango yako inahifadhiwa

onboarding_sync_enabled_note.message: Data iliyokubali hapa chini itakuwa ikitumia Chrome Sync baada ya kumaliza kuanzisha.

onboarding_sync_disabled_note.message: All Fokasi Lock data stays in this Chrome profile.

onboarding_sync_developer_note.message: Nothing is sent to the Fokasi Lock developer.
